'''Brent Haertlin''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[RamapoCon II Constructed (5 May, 7 pm)]] on 5 May 2000 with mains deck (no objective), according to Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d723">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-10-ramapocon-ii-5-5-5-7d723/ ramapocon-ii-5-5-5-7], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 10 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-10-ramapocon-ii-5-5-5-7d723/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
